title: A notify target to add
description: What notify_targets.add takes: a webhook the owner's agents' notices are posted to, and the secret that signs them.

name.description: What agents' definitions route to, as notify: ops. Letters, digits, - and _, up to 32.

url.description: Where notices are posted, over https. Checked as it's added and as each notice is sent.

secret.description: Signs each notice's body, as a secret the owner keeps in the vault. It's read as each notice is sent, so a new value takes effect at once.

name.description: The secret's name in the owner's vault.
